verdict: Uses real bl-switch and bl-select elements, but the options are authored with a hallucinated <bl-option> tag (the real component is bl-select-option, confirmed via `baklava components`) so the language list will not render; the select also omits its idiomatic `label` attribute and the switches are left without an accessible name. Because of the invalid option tag and weak label wiring it scores well below the augmented arm.
